actual_point_value_BV_convention: Both left-limit to actual value and actual value to right-limit jumps count, including singleton contacts and the periodic seam. Open/closed threshold probabilities use F(t-) and F(t); the continuous law has the same limits, but the hybrid may have atoms.
radial_closed_band: For fixed other pairs and ideal angle, each exact unclipped stock is c*exp(beta*r), c>0. The basket is convex on r>=0. Its closed sublevel is an interval; removing its open lower sublevel leaves at most two closed intervals, possibly singleton contacts. Each costs at most two pointwise jumps, hence TV<=4. The map s->sqrt(s) preserves this variation.
angular_closed_band: The pinned original positive-role/kappa<sqrt2 polar theorem applies after replacing the CURRENT pair radius by bounded native Rhat. The exact ideal-angle basket has one max/min or is constant. A closed finite band is at most two arcs, including extrema ties, hence circular pointwise TV<=4. No claim applies to native rounded cosine or clipped finance.
whole_pair_transport: Replace each CURRENT pair radius first and its angle second. Other independent pairs only modify positive weights. A band costs 4*DS+4/(2N). All source drivers through date j occupy ceil((na+1)*j/2) WHOLE blocks; an unused future partner remains in its joint law.
continuous_anti_concentration: Only in the continuous reference, a stock at date j factors its shared common Gaussian: B_j=exp(s_j*Z)*W, W>0 independent of Z, s_j^2=sigma^2*rho*j/nt. Conditional closed-band log length is log(Uj/Lj)/s_j; standard normal density<=1/sqrt(2pi). Integrate W without conditioning on survival, clipping or a radius event. Add the separate whole-pair band allowance, then the union bound for switches.
clipping_and_band: Native stock>=0, exact binary basket1/na, and BOTH native S_N(U)>=na*H and ideal exp(U-lambda)>na*H exclude upper-clip events from either survivor. Lower clip leaks at most ell. Summing the stock envelope and paying the basket floor gives a_j*B_H-beta-eps<=B_N<=b_j*B_H+ell. Opposite strict barrier decisions force the CLOSED band [(H-ell)/b_j,(H+beta+eps)/a_j], retaining native equality and all endpoint ties.
survival_and_smooth: For integer date stock sum S_raw, floor(S_raw/na)<H*Q implies S_raw<na*H*Q. On both-path strict survival, each unrounded mean<H. Inverting a_j and b_j envelope gives mean-stock error<=H*max(1-a_j,b_j-1)+max(beta,ell). The source averages ALL stock words: divide the sum of date errors by nt, pay actual average-literal error against total<na*nt*H and its one floor. Positive part with exact same strike is 1-Lipschitz; pay native discount literal and final floor. Both nonnegative payoffs lie in [0,40], so a switch costs40.

Bridge=zeta+40*P_H(any switch), Total=H_price+Bridge.
